name: 2008 EV5
notes_source: Keck KISS 2012 canonical low-dv target; C-type primitive; NHATS-accessible. dv per KISS / NHATS.

name: 2009 BD
notes_source: Very small (~4 m); extremely low rendezvous dv; candidate for whole-body capture not boulder-pluck. NHATS list.

name: 2010 GA6
notes_source: ~22 m; NHATS-accessible mid-range dv. Spectral class not well constrained.

name: 2000 SG344
notes_source: Low dv; possible spent-rocket-body ambiguity historically; small natural body candidate. NHATS.

name: Bennu
notes_source: OSIRIS-REx returned 121.6 g (2023); hydrated phyllosilicates confirmed; rendezvous dv near 7 km/s upper edge of band. Sample-anchored water fraction.

name: Ryugu
notes_source: Hayabusa2 returned 5.4 g (2020); measured bulk water fraction low (~0.4%); larger body, dv near band edge. Sample-anchored low water-fraction case.
